summary: Old metal-frame fire tower at Mont Morissette in Blue Sea, dated to about 1945 and kept in the regional park, reachable on foot or by car.

facts.design: Metal-frame fire tower, listed as Tour de feu; a 2016 article calls it steel

access.note: The regional park is free to enter and parking is free (2016 article). A 2021 article says the tower can be reached on foot by the trails, by car or by quad.

visit.trail_note: About 13 km of marked trails in the park; the 2016 article describes a 2.1 km climb to the summit. A newer 18 m (59 ft) observation tower stands beside the old one.

events.note: The provincial register dates construction to about 1945 ('vers 1945').

notes_for_editor: Coordinates on the brief match the register point (46 deg 13 min 18.65 sec N, 76 deg 5 min 39.52 sec W). The register's 'vers 1945' is the only construction date read. A Tripadvisor search snippet (not fetched, not used) gives 1930 for the Blue Sea tower; check before any date change. No source read names who maintains the tower, so the brief's agency is not stated as a fact; the park is named only as the place the tower stands. The steel tower is not described as open to climbing and the story does not suggest it. The 2021 article is the newest status source.
